text: **An external TMT design with tissue crossed with plex exists.** In Jiang 2020 each TMT run holds up to 8 tissues from several donors (56 runs, 448 samples, Cramér's V run × tissue 0.324, 424 of 528 tissue pairs estimable within a run) versus MoTrPAC PROT (V = 1.000, 0 of 21).
